RFC7012-4-1.note: TestIPFIXFlowTemplate checks the E bit on all 11 fields (so ids stay <= 32767) but pins exact IE ids for only fields 0, 4 and 9. A template that emitted IE id 0 in any other field stays green, so the 'range of 1-32767' lower bound is not asserted for the emitted template. Single-polarity marker.
